$comment: The founding-adopter window, machine-readable so tools/check-adopters.js rule 5 reads a date rather than parsing prose. Basis: governance/IAR-0007. The window closes at the earlier of closesAt and committee constitution, the same instant IAR-0006 expires. On constitution, the pull request that marks IAR-0006 expired sets constitutedOn to the constitution date (YYYY-MM-DD); an entry declared on or after that date may not carry founding: true.
